Average body mass by species (grams): Adelie 3738.04, Chinstrap 3784.38, Gentoo 5105.00 (41 rows used).

Problems found and fixed:
1. species: one misspelling "Adeile" (row 2) merged into the allowed label "Adelie" (normalize_labels, approved) — otherwise Adelie's average would have been split.
2. body_mass_g: row 26 had 4,850,000 g, far outside the rules range 2500–6500 g (likely extra zeros). Excluded (approved) rather than guessed; it would have inflated the species average enormously.
3. One exact duplicate row (row 22) removed (approved) so a single penguin wasn't counted twice.

Caveats: the excluded row 26 was a real penguin with an unreadable mass — if its true value can be recovered (e.g. 4850 g), the affected species average would shift slightly. Other columns not used by this question (island whitespace variants, sex "FEMALE" variant, 3 missing sex values) were left untouched since they don't affect the species averages.
